headline: Plenty in the pipe

highlights: Revised land compensation guidelines have prompted PWGR to widen FY27 commissioning guidance to INR 250–300bn (INR 300bn earlier), even as capex guidance moves up to INR 370–400bn (INR 370bn earlier).
